unit.why: A short anecdote: R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov's son-in-law reports seeing the note the tsaddik sent by messenger to the graves of the Ari and Rashbi, signed 'your disciple'.
unit.boundary_note: previous division ends with the attribution 'אמר הה"ק ר׳ צבי הירש מזידיטשוב ז״ל', which may be a misplaced heading for this division

stories.start_quote: סיפר חתנו הה״ק מראזלא מוה״ר יהודא צבי
stories.end_quote: וחתם עצמו תלמידך צבי בן הינדא
stories.summary_en: R. Yehuda Zvi of Rozdil testifies that he saw a note his father-in-law, R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov, sent with a man to the graves of the Ari and R. Shimon bar Yochai, signed 'your disciple Zvi son of Hinda'.

quotes: ששלח פתקא ביד איש אחד על ציון

the graves in Safed and Meron are the note's destination
